Comment "PROFILE" to find which side of the table you're on. The market doesn't create money — it moves it, from the impatient to the patient. Every dollar you lose went into someone calmer's account. You're not trading the chart, you're trading a person. Swipe to see which hand you are. THE LINE — if you can't name the impatient one at the table, it's you.
